name: kidschinese-firestore-rules-tests
description: Tests for firebase/firestore.rules with the Firestore emulator. Needs Java 11 or later.

scripts.test: firebase emulators:exec --project demo-kidschinese --only firestore --config firebase.json "node --test tests/firestore.rules.test.mjs"
scripts.e2e: firebase emulators:exec --project demo-kidschinese --only auth,firestore --config firebase.json "node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/app.e2e.mjs"
